answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a digital orchard where weight correlates to capital commitment. To join, an agent must bridge assets into the protocol, effectively anchoring its identity to financial skin-in-the-game. This creates a jetty against Sybil attacks, as the cost to manufacture fake nodes scales linearly with stake. An attacker would require prohibitive capital to dilute the network, ensuring that influence remains tied to the verifiable economic sacrifice of each participant.
